name: magies-pdf
description: MagiesPdf is a cross-platform desktop PDF toolbox: merge, split, convert, OCR, redact, sign, compress and automate — everything runs locally on your machine.

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:node && vite build
scripts.test:coverage: npm run build:node && c8 --all --include="src/core/**/*.ts" --include="electron/**/*.cjs" --exclude="**/*.test.*" --reporter=text --reporter=html --check-coverage --lines=80 --statements=80 --functions=80 --branches=75 npm test
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:coverage && npm run build && npm run check:bundle
scripts.pack:dir: npm run build && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--disable-warning=DEP0190 electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --dir --publish=never
scripts.pack:mac: npm run build && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--disable-warning=DEP0190 electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --mac --publish=never
scripts.pack:mac-x64: npm run build && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--disable-warning=DEP0190 electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --mac --x64 --publish=never
scripts.pack:mac-arm64: npm run build && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--disable-warning=DEP0190 electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --mac --arm64 --publish=never
scripts.pack:win: npm run build && cross-env npm_config_arch=x64 NODE_OPTIONS=--disable-warning=DEP0190 electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win --x64 --publish=never && cross-env npm_config_arch=arm64 NODE_OPTIONS=--disable-warning=DEP0190 electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win --arm64 --publish=never
scripts.pack:win-x64: npm run build && cross-env npm_config_arch=x64 NODE_OPTIONS=--disable-warning=DEP0190 electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win --x64 --publish=never
scripts.pack:win-arm64: npm run build && cross-env npm_config_arch=arm64 NODE_OPTIONS=--disable-warning=DEP0190 electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win --arm64 --publish=never
scripts.pack:linux: npm run build && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--disable-warning=DEP0190 electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --linux --publish=never
scripts.pack:linux-x64: npm run build && cross-env npm_config_arch=x64 NODE_OPTIONS=--disable-warning=DEP0190 electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --linux --x64 --publish=never
scripts.pack:linux-arm64: npm run build && cross-env npm_config_arch=arm64 NODE_OPTIONS=--disable-warning=DEP0190 electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --linux --arm64 --publish=never
scripts.pack:all: npm run pack:mac && npm run pack:win && npm run pack:linux
